conflicts.description: Masiyiwa's start day. The 8-K says he was appointed on 2020-12-16 with the appointment 'effective immediately', and the press release is dated 2020-12-16. His Form 3 gives an event date of 2020-12-24. The 8-K date is recorded.

Start of Hastings' CEO tenure. The 2002 IPO prospectus says he has been CEO 'since September 1998' and President 'since July 1999'. The 2026 proxy's career snapshot says 'Chief Executive Officer, President (1999-January 2023)'. The ceo_director role uses the prospectus (1998-09) at medium confidence.

open_questions: Current board size (11) is implied, not stated: the 2026 proxy lists 13 directors, Hastings left at the 2026-06-04 meeting and Sweeney resigned 2026-07-26. No filing reviewed states the authorized number of directors, and Netflix's 8-Ks never disclosed an authorized-size change, so no BOARD_SIZE_CHANGE events are recorded.

Compensation Committee after Sweeney's 2026-07-26 resignation: no filing names a replacement. By subtraction the committee would be Döpfner and Kilgore (Chair), but this is not stated. Committee rosters are as of the 2026 proxy (filed 2026-04-16) and were not re-disclosed after the 2026 meeting, except that the 2026-06-05 8-K says Hoag still chairs Nominating and Governance.

Pre-IPO and early start dates are month or year precision only: Hastings 1997 (prospectus 'Chairman of the Board since inception', inception 1997-08-29, but no filing states his board start day), Haley 1998-06, Hoag 1999-06, Barton 2002-05 (the S-1/A management table dated as of 2002-05-02 already lists him; the 2002-04-16 S-1/A does not).

Day Hoag became lead independent director is not disclosed: 'since 2012' per the 2026 8-K; the 2012 proxy (2012-04-20) says no lead independent director had been appointed and the 2013 proxy (2013-04-26) says the position was 'recently created'.
Kilgore's independence start is disclosed only as 'since 2015' (year).
Independence roles are aligned to board tenure; filings give point-in-time determinations only (proxies 2020-2026 reviewed, plus the 2020 proxy's 'Independent Director since' labels).
Hastings' 1997-to-1998-09 period: he was Chairman, but filings reviewed do not say whether he was an employee before becoming CEO.

Other-board lists come from Netflix's own bios and are not checked against other issuers' filings. Belmer's 2022 bio names CEO-and-director roles at Atos SE and Eutelsat while its 'Other Public Company Boards' field reads None; Hastings' 2026 bio names Bloomberg LP and Anthropic PBC boards; neither set is recorded as public-company boards.
Hoag's 2025 failed majority vote: he tendered a conditional resignation on 2025-06-05 and the Board rejected it on 2025-06-22. Recorded as continuous service, not a departure.

coverage.method: Roster from the 2026 DEF 14A (filed 2026-04-16), reconciled with every 8-K filed after it (Item 5.02 on 2026-04-16 and 2026-07-30; Item 5.07/8.01 on 2026-06-05; Items 8.01/2.02 checked) and the monthly director Form 4 option grants of 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-01 (nine non-employee directors) plus the co-CEOs' August 2026 Forms 4. EDGAR submissions feed reviewed through 2026-10-02.

Every DEF 14A 2020-2026 and every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07 filed 2019-12 through 2026-10-02 reviewed; departures dated from 8-K Item 5.02 effective dates or the Item 5.07 annual-meeting date. Director Form 3s cross-checked.

Only seats of directors serving on or after 2020-01-01 are reconstructed (from the 2002 IPO prospectus, 2002 S-1/A, 2010-2018 appointment 8-Ks, 2012/2013 proxies and Form 3s). Directors who left before 2020 (e.g., A. George Battle, retired 2018-12-15) are out of scope and not recorded.
